key_observation: At the center x=0, nonlinear Christoffel products vanish (O(r^2)). The linearized Ricci of the Weyl direction is zero by construction. So Ric = lam*g + O(A') + O(A'') + O(r^2). For |A'|,|A''| <= delta, the operator-norm defect is O(delta). The 10-dim Weyl space gives full freedom to traverse curvature eigenvalues.
